body:
Welcome back again,

This report goes to a few people. 
     Let me explain, so let's start where it all started... with steven5703. Yes he was my friend, but no longer is. The reason why, he is making insulting and offensive comments to me and i believe that he should be temp banned. He tries to do this to be cool in front of michael. So yes i may not have proof but you can listen in and see all the hurtful stuff he says. "Wow i am surprised you haven't mute him already" "Shut up" "Go away" and he hates and constantly hates on thing i like example Karaoke Party. Also, he gives info like we live right next to each other and i only say that if the person already knows that. And to be exact this happens a total i would guess 8 times a day. I will take action if avicus won't.


       Thanks for you reason and i will chat with you later.
